title: Digital Supply Chain Technical Lead
description: Management Sciences for Health (MSH) is a global health nonprofit that makes foundational changes to health systems to protect people from diseases and improve their health. MSH collaborates with local partners, from the Ministry of Health to the community, to strengthen and complement existing health systems. Since 1971, MSH has worked in more than 150 countries to help ensure sustainable, resilient, and equitable access to quality health care around the globe. MSH is seeking a Technical Lead – Digital Supply Chain for a potential Gates Foundation-funded project in Ethiopia focused on improving last-mile visibility of vaccines and reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health (RMNCH) commodities. The project will support the Government of Ethiopia to strengthen its digital supply chain ecosystem through improved commodity visibility, digital integration and interoperability, governance, accountability, and data use. The project will assess the existing digital supply chain ecosystem, pilot priority digital integration solutions, and support sustainable scale-up and transition to government ownership. This position is subject to project award and funding. Overall Responsibilities The Digital Supply Chain Lead will provide technical leadership for the design, integration, and implementation of the project's digital supply chain architecture and solutions. The Lead will work closely with the Project Lead, Government of Ethiopia counterparts, and technical partners to strengthen interoperability and integration across existing supply chain and health information systems and improve end-to-end visibility of vaccines and RMNCH commodities. The Lead will guide the assessment of Ethiopia's existing digital supply chain ecosystem, development of the future-state architecture and implementation roadmap, and design and implementation of priority digital integration pilots. The position will ensure solutions are scalable, user-centered, aligned with Ethiopia's national digital health architecture and strategies, and designed for sustainable government ownership. Specific Responsibilities Digital Supply Chain Architecture and Technical Leadership Lead the assessment and mapping of Ethiopia's digital supply chain ecosystem, including systems, data flows, interoperability, infrastructure, and key gaps. Lead development of the future-state digital supply chain architecture and implementation roadmap, a ligned with national digital health strategies and architecture. Provide technical leadership for interoperability, system integration, data exchange standards, master data and registries, and integration of existing transactional supply chain systems. Ensure digital solutions strengthen existing government platforms and processes rather than create duplicative or parallel systems. Guide the design, configuration, integration, testing, and implementation of priority digital solutions and pilots to improve end-to-end commodity visibility. Identify opportunities to apply advanced analytics, automation, AI, and digital decision-support tools to improve forecasting, inventory management, commodity availability, and supply chain decision-making. Implementation, Data Use, and Government Ownership Work with supply chain and government counterparts to ensure digital solutions address priority operational and user needs at national, regional, and facility levels. Support improvements in data quality, availability, visualization, and routine use of supply chain data for operational and strategic decision-making. Develop technical standards, documentation, specifications, and guidance necessary to support implementation, interoperability, scale-up, and sustainability. Build the capacity of government technical teams to manage, maintain, adapt, and govern digital supply chain systems and integrations. Support evaluation of pilot solutions and translate findings into recommendations and requirements for sustainable scale-up. Support progressive transfer of technical knowledge, tools, and system-management responsibilities to appropriate government institutions. Coordination and Technical Management Work closely with the Ministry of Health, Ethiopian Pharmaceutical Supply Service (EPSS), Regional Health Bureaus (RHBs), Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority (EFDA), and other relevant government stakeholders. Coordinate with technology vendors, implementing partners, donors, local organizations, and other digital health initiatives to promote interoperability, alignment, and efficient use of existing investments. description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration.
